judge.rationale: The candidate only wrote a definition-of-done file (`.lore/dod.md`) and test files (`registry.acceptance.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`), without actually implementing any of the production changes in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` or adding `ajv` to `package.json`. Consequently, nearly all the newly added tests will fail immediately when run, and the test for function-valued tool definitions even passes a function as `inputSchema` rather than passing a function-valued `ToolDefinitionSource` to `register` (which violates the TypeScript types). Furthermore, the candidate named the test file `registry.acceptance.test.ts` instead of the required `registry.test.ts`, and omitted all required updates to `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, and `CHANGELOG.md`.
